name: Red Panda
intro: A red panda is a furry red animal that lives in trees. It lives in the mountains of Asia.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A red panda has red-brown fur.
Its face is white with red marks.
It has big, pointed ears.
Its legs and belly are black.
Its bushy tail has rings and is almost as long as its body.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Red pandas live in the mountains of Asia.
They live in cool forests with lots of bamboo.
They spend most of their time in trees.
They sleep high up on tree branches.
Their red fur blends in with red moss on the trees.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Red pandas eat mostly bamboo leaves.
They also eat fruit, acorns, and flowers.
Sometimes they eat eggs or small birds.
They nibble one leaf at a time.
A special wrist bone helps them hold bamboo.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby red panda is called a cub.
The mom makes a cozy den in a hollow tree.
A new cub has gray fur and closed eyes.
Its fur turns red as it grows.
Cubs leave the den at about 3 months old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Red pandas wrap their tails around them to stay warm.
They climb down trees headfirst.
They lick themselves clean, like cats do.
Red pandas are not close cousins of giant pandas.
One Chinese name for the red panda means fire fox.

vocab.meaning: A tall plant with long green leaves.

An animal with fur that feeds its babies milk.
